about.title: About Me
about.header:
Hi, I'm Yusuf, 

For me, code is more than just syntax; it’s a creative process. I enjoy imagining ideas, experimenting with technologies, and turning concepts into real, interactive experiences. Every project is a new opportunity to grow and push the boundaries of what I can create.

This site is a window into my work — past, present, and what's yet to come.
